title: Sales Tax Calculator
description: Add sales tax to a price or back it out of a tax-inclusive total, with any tax rate you set.
howto: Choose whether to add tax to a price or extract tax from a total.
Enter the amount and your local sales tax rate.
Read the tax amount and the final price instantly.
Switch modes to reverse the calculation.

faqs.q: How do I find the price before tax from a tax-inclusive total?
faqs.a: Choose "Extract tax from total" and enter the total. The tool divides by (1 + rate) to recover the pre-tax price.

faqs.q: What if my area has multiple stacked taxes?
faqs.a: Enter the combined rate. For example, a 5% state tax plus a 2% city tax is a single 7% rate here.

faqs.q: Does this handle VAT the same way?
faqs.a: Yes. VAT is mathematically identical to sales tax for this purpose: add mode applies it, extract mode backs it out.
